notes.title: Update 1.1 - Graphical options
notes.notes:
Added options for toggling full-screen, changing resolution and graphics quality.
Modified UI so that it should display properly on 4:3 monitors.

notes.title: Hotfix 2
notes.notes:
Prevented pickups from falling below the ground or rising above the camera
Fixed "Scare Car" mode always being enabled.

notes.title: Release hotfix 1
notes.notes: Hotfix: Pickups should now actually be picked up by the player
